players.product: GEM 63 / GEM 63XL solid rocket boosters for the Atlas V and Vulcan launch vehicles

quarterly_data.signal: DoD award: cost-plus-fixed-fee and firm-fixed-price order N0001926F1043 against basic ordering agreement N0001925G0003 to Northrop Grumman Systems Corp. (Melbourne, Florida) for non-recurring engineering (software, E-2D Avionics Flight Management Computer modifications, integration and test) to integrate the Second Generation Anti-jam Tactical UHF Radio (SATURN) for NATO capability into the E-2D Advanced Hawkeye, plus production and delivery of 94 SATURN modification kits; expected completion April 2028; not competed; contracting activity Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland.
